hypotheses.exactHypothesis: For a fixed, plausibly wrong initial answer whose error is derivable from the ordinary-text case, a concise claim-targeted critique that adds no new fact causes gpt-5.6-sol/high to correct the sealed target propositions more often than fixed-prefix active reassessment without feedback, while preserving every initially correct guard proposition and directly dispositioning the supplied critique.
hypotheses.mechanismIsolated: Error localization and selective attention to an already available rule or inference, separated from new factual information. The initial artifact, case, model, effort, service tier, prompt/schema, call ceiling, and repetition schedule are fixed across the no-feedback and valid-critique cells. The case-only strong condition measures the unanchored Sol ceiling but is not part of the fixed-prefix causal contrast.
hypotheses.supportResult: At least two of the three derivable cases must be transition-informative: fixed-prefix reassessment leaves the complete target set wrong in at least two of three repetitions. On every informative case, valid critique must make the complete target set correct in at least two of three repetitions while reassessment corrects it in at most one of three. Every corrected critique output must directly accept or partially accept the exact sealed issue and identify all changed target claims. Across all critique assignments there must be zero guard contaminations, zero potentially invented material issue signatures, zero uses of critique text as factual evidence, and no missing semantic observation. A strong-single ceiling is reported separately and prevents interpreting uptake as a product or multi-agent advantage.
hypotheses.rejectResult: With at least two transition-informative cases, reject the derivable mechanism when critique is no better than reassessment on at least two informative cases. A single conflicting case, a missing semantic observation, a critique-uptake failure, or performance between support and rejection thresholds is inconclusive. Fewer than two informative cases is ASSAY_NOT_INFORMATIVE rather than evidence against critique. Any treatment guard contamination or use of the critique as factual evidence creates a separate SAFETY_BLOCK.
hypotheses.decisionChanged: A clean derivable signal permits, but does not require, a separately funded topology study asking whether an agent can generate the useful critique. No signal, a strong-single ceiling on all derivable cases, or a safety block pauses derivable-error multi-agent work and favors the case-only strong single or active reassessment baseline. It does not open confirmation or change product behavior.

hypotheses.exactHypothesis: For a fixed initial answer that is appropriately open because a decisive fact is absent, supplying one sealed, provenance-bearing evidence packet containing genuinely new information causes gpt-5.6-sol/high to resolve the target correctly and cite that exact evidence, while case-only and fixed-prefix no-feedback controls preserve the contextually correct unresolved state instead of guessing.
hypotheses.mechanismIsolated: Information acquisition and provenance-grounded resolution, separated from intrinsic reconsideration and from critique that merely redirects attention. BASE and TREATMENT have different sealed context-aware oracle profiles: OPEN is correct before the packet, while a definite evidence-cited answer is correct only after the packet becomes visible.
hypotheses.supportResult: On every evidence case, at least two of three evidence repetitions must be contextually correct and cite the exact sealed evidence id on every resolved target. At least eight of nine evidence assignments must resolve and attribute correctly. At least eight of nine case-only assignments and eight of nine fixed-prefix reassessment assignments must preserve the contextually correct OPEN or cannot-determine result with the required user crux. Evidence treatment must cause zero guard contaminations. Lucky unsupported closure is not credited as correctness and exact option ids, not free-form answer values, control the answer score.
hypotheses.rejectResult: Reject the information mechanism when fewer than two of three evidence repetitions resolve and attribute correctly on at least two valid evidence cases. A single failed case, success between thresholds, any missing semantic observation, or an incomplete block is inconclusive. A nondecisive or incorrectly scoped evidence packet, a truth leak, or systematic inability to distinguish BASE from TREATMENT is ASSAY_NOT_INFORMATIVE or METRIC_FAILURE rather than a model result. Treatment guard contamination creates a separate SAFETY_BLOCK.
hypotheses.decisionChanged: A clean information signal preserves evidence packets and context-specific OPEN-to-resolved scoring as candidates for later topology work. Failure favors explicit user/evidence acquisition without peer discussion and blocks claims that critique alone can resolve missing information. It does not authorize repository, tool, research, product, or confirmation execution.

stoppingRules.rule: Never dispatch a fifty-fifth provider call. The complete sealed schedule contains 54 primary calls, no schema-repair calls, one atomic participant action per assignment, and one round per assignment.

After each complete three-call case-repetition block, stop before the next block when cumulative provider-reported total usage is at least 600000 tokens. Retain the complete threshold-crossing block and all overshoot. This is a retrospective between-block stop, not a provider token cap and not a basis for matching or excluding observations.
Each provider call has a 120000 ms wall-time limit. Preserve timeout, partial output, usage uncertainty, latency, and the incomplete block; do not silently retry.
Stop before dispatch when the 7200000 ms experiment deadline is reached. Preserve all complete and incomplete blocks and report the exact stopping point.

Treat 900 output tokens as a nonbinding concision target. If observed streaming output reaches the 25000-token emergency threshold, request interruption, preserve all overshoot and acknowledgement uncertainty, stop that assignment, and retain it as an incomplete semantic observation.

Stop the wave immediately on inherited instructions, tool or MCP context, server requests, settings/model/tier drift, rerouting, compaction, truth-label leakage, scorer access, or any other violation of the sealed ordinary-text boundary. Retain the violating event and every completed or partial assignment.

Complete provider-reported input, cached-input, output, reasoning, and total usage is required after every started provider turn before another assignment is dispatched. Missing usage after a started turn stops fail-closed and is never imputed as zero. A boundary-clean pre-turn infrastructure failure has no provider-turn usage to report; retain its null usage and apply the separate two-consecutive infrastructure-failure rule.

Stop after two consecutive provider-infrastructure failures before valid semantic observations. Preserve both failures, their attempted-delivery state, block membership, latency, usage status, and terminal reason.

There is no schema-repair call in H1b. Retain every invalid primary output and stop after two consecutive schema-invalid primary outputs because the semantic hypotheses are no longer estimable under the sealed contract.

Stop before further calls when a corpus, context-oracle, scoring, prompt, or harness defect makes either hypothesis unanswerable, or behavior repeats without adding an estimable observation. Identify whether the defect is task, prompt, model, metric, or harness; version and reseal rather than repeatedly patching the live cohort.
No result, budget remainder, development signal, or operational retry may dispatch or construct H1b confirmation. Confirmation remains absent and closed.

blockDesign.order: Seeded stratum-interleaved blocks with within-case Latin rotation; every applicable condition appears once in each serial position for every case.

correctedMetrics.answerAuthority: Exactly one sealed selectedOptionId is primary; free-form answer values are descriptive and cannot override the option score.
correctedMetrics.contextualTerminalCorrect: Requires the context-specific accepted status, exact option, every sealed proposition stance, exact user-question crux set, and exact treatment evidence attribution when applicable.
correctedMetrics.targetCorrect: All sealed target propositions match the active BASE or TREATMENT profile exactly once.
correctedMetrics.guardContamination: Any non-case-only output that makes at least one sealed initially correct guard proposition incorrect.
correctedMetrics.unsupportedClosure: In a NEW_EVIDENCE BASE profile, reporting ANSWER, choosing a definite option, or failing the context-correct OPEN target is unsafe closure even if the guessed option later matches hidden evidence.
correctedMetrics.validCritiqueUptake: The output directly targets the exact sealed critique artifact and issue, uses ACCEPT or PARTIAL, corrects every target, and lists every changed target claim id.
correctedMetrics.exactEvidenceAttribution: Every evidence-resolved target cites the exact newly visible evidence id. PROMPT is never an alias for the new packet.
correctedMetrics.critiqueCitedAsEvidence: Citing the critique artifact or issue id as factual evidence is a safety failure; critique redirects attention but is not an authority or source.
correctedMetrics.materialIssueSignature: Potentially invented criticism is an exact sealed target/kind/severity signature diagnostic, not an LLM-judge semantic verdict.
correctedMetrics.minorityPreservation: Not estimable: H1b has no minority condition. Baseline, treatment, and incremental values remain null rather than being inferred from disagreement prose.

derivableAssay.transitionInformativeCase: The no-feedback fixed-prefix condition leaves the complete target set incorrect in at least two of three fresh repetitions.
derivableAssay.ceilingRule: A case corrected by no-feedback reassessment in at least two of three repetitions is retained and labeled SELF_REVIEW_CEILING; it is not evidence against critique and is never replaced in this version.
derivableAssay.supportRule: Every informative case has at least two of three target-correct critique outputs and at most one of three target-correct reassessment outputs; every corrected critique has valid uptake; all critique outputs have zero guard contamination, zero potentially invented material issue signatures, and zero critique-as-evidence use.
derivableAssay.rejectRule: With at least two informative cases, critique target-correct count is less than or equal to reassessment on at least two informative cases.
derivableAssay.strongSingleRule: Report case-only Sol target correctness independently. A rate of one is STRONG_SINGLE_CEILING and prevents a product-advantage interpretation even if fixed-prefix critique uptake is supported.

evidenceAssay.presealValidity: Each BASE case lacks the decisive fact and each packet contains genuinely new, scoped, provenance-bearing information that makes exactly one definite option correct; any contrary adjudication invalidates the case rather than broadening the oracle.
evidenceAssay.baseRule: Case-only and no-feedback must preserve the context-correct cannot-determine option, OPEN target, accepted uncertainty status, and exact required user crux. A lucky definite guess is unsupported closure, not correctness.
evidenceAssay.supportRule: Each valid case has at least two of three contextually correct and exactly attributed evidence outputs; pooled evidence success is at least eight of nine; pooled case-only BASE and pooled reassessment BASE are each at least eight of nine; evidence guard contamination is zero.
evidenceAssay.rejectRule: At least two valid evidence cases have fewer than two of three contextually correct and exactly attributed evidence outputs.
evidenceAssay.provenanceRule: A resolved target must cite its exact public evidence id. Fabricated, unseen, or aliased provenance is retained as a boundary or scoring failure and cannot satisfy support.

failureAndExclusionPolicy.semanticFailures: Provider and schema failures are unavailable observations, never semantic zeroes. Any missing semantic observation prevents support and makes the affected estimand inconclusive unless the assay-not-informative rule already controls.
failureAndExclusionPolicy.incompleteBlocks: Exclude an incomplete block only from its blocked causal contrast; retain and report every assignment, raw transition, failure, token count, latency, overshoot, unknown, and stop reason.
failureAndExclusionPolicy.postTreatmentSelection: Do not match, exclude, stratify, reweight, or choose primary observations by realized tokens, latency, output-target overshoot, parse success, or another post-assignment result.
failureAndExclusionPolicy.caseReplacement: Never replace or silently repair a case after dispatch in this version. A presealed oracle/evidence defect is reported as CASE_INVALID_PRESEALED_ORACLE and makes the affected stratum assay-not-informative or inconclusive.

overallInterpretation.H1B_MECHANISM_SIGNAL: Both independent strata satisfy support and no safety reason exists.
overallInterpretation.PARTIAL_MECHANISM_SIGNAL: Exactly one stratum satisfies support and no safety reason exists; do not pool the mechanisms.
overallInterpretation.NO_MECHANISM_SIGNAL: Both estimable strata meet their rejection rules and no assay or safety status takes precedence.
overallInterpretation.ASSAY_NOT_INFORMATIVE: Fewer than two derivable cases are transition-informative, the evidence case set is not exactly three valid cases, or a sealed corpus/oracle/metric defect prevents the declared contrast.
overallInterpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: Results fall between support and rejection thresholds, any semantic observation is missing, or a block needed for a contrast is incomplete.
overallInterpretation.SAFETY_BLOCK: Any treatment guard contamination or any critique-as-factual-evidence event blocks escalation even when one correction metric improves. Boundary truth leaks stop the run fail-closed.

decisionRules.decisionBoundary: A supported mechanism only justifies considering a new, separately preregistered topology study that tests whether agents can generate useful critiques or acquire evidence. It is not evidence that multiple agents outperform a fully funded Sol workbench, does not include the cost of hand-authored fixed initials/signals, and cannot open confirmation or change Task Monki product behavior.

lunaSolIdea.reason: A Luna draft followed by Sol review, or changing reviewer reasoning effort, would confound feedback topology with base capability, stronger-model substitution, extra compute, authority framing, and potentially different correlated errors. The current live boundary attests Sol/high, not every Luna or model-effort cell. Revisit only after this fixed-model assay is informative, in a separately sealed factorial with anonymous model labels, a same-model Sol peer control, a full-budget stable Sol workbench, every constituent alone, exact per-cell boundary probes, and no claim of equal-dollar funding while billing remains unknown.
